title: reduction: .harness/config/reduction.json
description: Project facts for the reduction skill. The file is optional: every key has a default or is autodetected, and a key left out keeps its default. Paths are relative to the project root. `$`-prefixed keys are ignored; any other unknown key is reported by reduction.py (`check` fails, the other commands warn and continue).

^\\$.description: A comment (for example `$comment`) or `$schema`; ignored by reduction.py.

analysisDir.description: Where the analysis files go, relative to the project root. Default: <harness>/analysis (`new` creates `.harness/analysis/` when the project has no harness).

sources.description: Source roots per stack. A stack left out is autodetected. reduction.py reads only `java` and `react` here and ignores other keys.

java.description: Roots whose *.java files are measured. Every root must be a directory (`check` fails otherwise). Default: autodetected, every Maven (pom.xml) or Gradle (build.gradle, build.gradle.kts) module that has src/main/java.

react.description: Roots whose .ts .tsx .js .jsx .mjs .cjs files are measured. Every root must be a directory. Default: autodetected, every directory with a package.json that depends on react, react-dom, next, typescript or @types/react, or that has a tsconfig.json; workspace roots are skipped.

uiPackage.description: The shared UI package (for example `@acme/ui`); null or an empty string means none. Default: autodetected when exactly one detected React project's package.json name ends in `ui`, `design-system` or `components`; otherwise none.

exclude.description: Globs (matched against `./<path relative to the root>`) of files never measured. Setting the key REPLACES the whole default list. Default: **/node_modules/**, **/target/**, **/build/**, **/dist/**, **/out/**, **/.next/**, **/.nuxt/**, **/.turbo/**, **/.gradle/**, **/coverage/**, **/generated/**, **/generated-sources/**, **/__generated__/**, **/vendor/**, **/third_party/**, **/.git/**, **/.harness/**, **/.claude/**, **/*.min.js, **/*.d.ts.

tests.description: Globs of test files, which never count toward the saving (`surface` leaves them out unless --tests is passed). Setting the key replaces the default list. Default: **/src/test/**, **/src/testFixtures/**, **/src/it/**, **/__tests__/**, **/test/**, **/tests/**, **/e2e/**, **/*.test.*, **/*.spec.*, **/*Test.java, **/*Tests.java, **/*IT.java.

decided.description: Decisions the project already carries: technique id (J1-J10, R1-R6, T1-T5, case-insensitive) -> a non-empty reason. `new` refuses to open an analysis for a decided technique without --force. Default: {}.

verify.description: Name -> command that phase 2 runs after every batch. Setting the key replaces the autodetected set. Default: autodetected (`./mvnw -q -pl <module> -am test` or `mvn ...` with a root pom.xml, `./gradlew :<module>:test` with a gradlew, `<pnpm|yarn|npm> test` when the root package.json has a test script).
